page.title: Account recovery
page.intro: Manual recovery needs two different moderators, each confirming with their passkey. After the second approval the account holder is warned and can cancel for 24 hours; then the second moderator gets a one-time enrollment link.

request.subject: Account reference
request.help: Copy it from the moderation queue or log.
request.created: Recovery opened. Give this ID to a second moderator:

approve.done: Approved. The 24-hour hold has started and the account holder has been warned.

link.result: One-time enrollment link. Hand it over only to the verified account holder:
